# Bloom UI

> Bloom UI is a professional React 19 component library built on top of Radix UI, Tailwind CSS v4, and Framer Motion. Clean neutral theme tokens, full accessibility standards, and high-performance micro-animations.

## Overview
- [Introduction](https://bloom.guibus.dev/): Main overview and core principles.
- [Installation](https://bloom.guibus.dev/installation): CLI setup guide and requirements.

## CLI Usage
To initialize Bloom UI in a project:
```bash
npx @bloomui-react/cli init
```

To add any component:
```bash
npx @bloomui-react/cli add <component-name>
```
